comparison_to_prior_baseline.role-parsimony-conformal-v1: That receipt trusted the fixture handles as ground truth; this one proves the handles are structurally faithful (parity 39/39) and the role verdict cannot be flipped by re-encoding the SMILES. The 24 in-domain resin/hardener assignments and the 12 fail-closed hostile nulls are reproduced from raw structure alone.

deterministic_role_rule.mechanism: epoxy-amine SN2 ring-opening: epoxide electrophile=>resin, amine N-H nucleophile=>hardener; dual or none=>ABSTAIN (fail-closed)

does_not_close: RDKit_C++_CEILING (SMARTS matcher is RDKit; a fully independent Phase-1 would cross-check a second cheminformatics toolkit)
interpretation: All four reactive-function handles were re-derived from raw SMILES for 39/39 records with byte-exact agreement to the declared facts, so the parsimony benchmark's inputs are structurally faithful, not asserted. The zero-parameter role rule assigned the expected verdict for 39/39 records and stayed invariant across 549 deterministic SMILES re-encodings, closing an encoding-evasion path: a molecule cannot change its resin/hardener/ABSTAIN role by being written differently. All 12 hostile nulls (dual-functional glycidyl-amines + non-reactive solvents) fail-closed to ABSTAIN. Validation only; no candidate, product, or promotion claim.
primary_references: Weininger, Weininger, Weininger (1989) SMILES 2 canonicalization. JCICS 29(2):97-101. doi:10.1021/ci00062a008
Daylight Theory Manual, SMARTS substructure specification (Daylight CIS).
May, C.A. (ed.) Epoxy Resins: Chemistry and Technology, 2nd ed. ISBN 978-0824776909 (amine-epoxide ring-opening).
purpose: Independently re-derive the four reactive-function handles from raw SMILES via RDKit SMARTS (never reading the fixture facts), gate them against the declared facts, and prove the zero-parameter deterministic role verdict is invariant across a deterministic SMILES-encoding sweep.

smarts_handles.amine_h_count_rule: sum of GetTotalNumHs over matched amine nitrogens
